phase_prompt.label: The Silent Administration
phase_prompt.summary: The Rulers stand high in the Gate Band, observing the pleas of the righteous as scrolling error text which they actively ignore, turning instead to assist the corrupt high-resource entities.
phase_prompt.prompt_block: A towering, obsidian-clad Ruler stands in a high-tech server cathedral, back turned to the camera. In the foreground, out of focus, translucent red holographic screens display pleading faces and Geez text (prayers) which are being auto-archived. The Ruler gazes toward a golden, corrupted light source representing the oppressors. The lighting is moody, with sharp rim lights accentuating the glossy black texture of the entity's armor against the deep void of the simulation's upper boundary. Photorealistic, cinematic drama, intense atmosphere.
